Marketing Officer Job at ICS Outsourcing




        
    

        
        ICS Outsourcing is Nigeria’s pioneer Human Resource Outsourcing Company. We are on a mission to provide world-class human resource solutions, using experts while creating value for our shareholders and opportunities in the community. Our vision is to be the most valuable Business Support Solutions Partner to our Clients throughout Africa and beyond.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing Officer
Job Location: Apapa, Isolo Oshodi - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Commercial Bank

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Develop and implement marketing strategies to drive business growth.
	Identify and acquire new customers.
	Promote the company's products and services to prospective clients.
	Build and maintain strong client relationships.
	Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
	Achieve assigned sales and business development targets.
	Prepare and submit periodic marketing reports.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Upper or Lower Credit
	Proven experience in marketing, sales, or business development.
	Strong communication and negotiation skills.
	Ability to work independently and meet targets.
	Good knowledge of customer relationship management.
	Age: 29yrs below.


Salary
N199,000 per month. 

Note: This is a marketing role

Operations Manager Job at University of Ilorin




        
    

        
        The University of Ilorin is located in the ancient city of Ilorin, about 500 kilometres from Abuja, the Federal capital. Ilorin, the Capital of Kwara State, is strategically located at the geographical and cultural confluence of the North and South. University of Ilorin was one of the seven institutions of higher learning established by a decree of the Federal Military Government in August, 1975. This step, taken to implement one of the educational directives of the country’s Third National Development Plan, was aimed at providing more opportunities for Nigerians aspiring to acquire university education and to generate high level man-power, so vital for the rapidly expanding economy.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Operations Manager

Job Location: Ilorin, Kwara

Requirements


	A Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or (OPERATIONS) Industrial  Engineering.
	10 to 15+ years of progressive experience in operations, with at least 5 years in a senior executive or director position.-level
	Relevant experience in the specific industry (e.g., manufacturing, logistics, tech, or retail), understanding its unique regulatory and market challenge.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their Applications with complete CV and academic documents to:
The Administrative Officer,
UNILORIN HOLDINGS Limited,
University of Ilorin,
Kwara State.

Manager (Zoo) Job at University of Ilorin




        
    

        
        The University of Ilorin is located in the ancient city of Ilorin, about 500 kilometres from Abuja, the Federal capital. Ilorin, the Capital of Kwara State, is strategically located at the geographical and cultural confluence of the North and South. University of Ilorin was one of the seven institutions of higher learning established by a decree of the Federal Military Government in August, 1975. This step, taken to implement one of the educational directives of the country’s Third National Development Plan, was aimed at providing more opportunities for Nigerians aspiring to acquire university education and to generate high level man-power, so vital for the rapidly expanding economy.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Manager (Zoo)

Job Location: Ilorin, Kwara

Requirements


	A Bachelor's Degree in Zoology, Biology, or a related field, combined with at least 5 years of experience in captive wildlife management. They must possess strong operational, financial, and team leadership skills
	Leadership & Management: A minimum of 2 -3 years in a supervisory role (such as Zoo Curator or Operations Manager), overseeing staff, budgets, and public exhibits.
	Degrees: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Zoology, Biology, Animal Science, or Veterinary Medicine with 5 or more years of experience caring for exotic species in accredited facilities.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their Applications with complete CV and academic documents to:
The Administrative Officer,
UNILORIN HOLDINGS Limited,
University of Ilorin,
Kwara State.

title: Job Openings at Daily Need Distributors Limited
content:
Daily Need Distributors Limited is a leading distribution company in West Africa with Head Office in FCT - Abuja. The company was registered as a limited liability company on June 22nd 1999, our philosophy is to build a long term profitable business relationship with P&G that's why we are 100% P&G dedicated company.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Van Sales Representative

Job Locations: Mabushi, Nyanya - Abuja (FCT) and  Suleja - Niger
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Ensure that goods get to customers as quickly as possible in short time.
	Participate in the day-to-day selling of products to customers.
	Coordinate with van sales supervisor and sales manager on the best professional way to infiltrate the market for sales increase.
	Good communication skills.
	Coordinate with the branch account in remitting daily sales cash.


Requirements


	Must have a minimum qualification of OND.
	0 - 1 years of experience in sales is required.
	Must be matured, responsible and well-mannered.
	Ability to read and write.
	Possession of a valid driver's license and not a learner's permit.
	Ability to drive manual vehicles and have knowledge of the preferred location route.
	Preferably a male.


Benefits


	Salary: N100,000 / Month.
	Annual leave allowance.
	Health insurance cover.
	Pension scheme.
	Career development programs.


Application Closing Date: 24th August, 2026.

Method of Appliction 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Preferred Location as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Market Sales Representative

Job Locations: Mabushi - Abuja (FCT)  and Lafia - Nasarawa
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities


	Ensure that goods get to our customers at a possible short time.
	Participate in the day-to-day selling of products to customers.
	Coordinate with Market Sales Supervisor/FSM and Sales Manager on the best professional way to infiltrate market for sales increase.
	Good communication skills.
	Coordinate with Branch Accountant in reconciling daily sales cash.


Minimum Requirements


	A minimum qualification of OND is required.
	0 to 3 years of experience in Sales in any FMCG is required.
	Must be matured, responsible and well-mannered.
	Ability to read and write.
	Candidates must reside within Mabushi, Utako and Lafia axis.
	Ability to sell.
	Candidate must possess qualities such as honesty, integrity and truthfulness.


Salary and Benefits


	Salary: N100,000 / Month.
	Annual leave allowance.
	Health insurance cover.
	Pension scheme.
	Career development programs.


Application Closing Date: 24th August, 2026.

Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Preferred Location as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Warehouse Assistant

Job Location: Nyanya, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	Ensure on a weekly and monthly basis and in line with the company’s standard operating procedures (SOPs) that warehouse stocks are confirmed at the branch level on time.
	Carry out a closing stock taking of all the sales representatives on a daily basis and report any irregularity discovered to your superior/senior internal control officer immediately and ensure all the company’s assets in the branch is highly safeguarded and controlled.
	Assisting the warehouse manager in the coordination of all logistics related activities in the branch.
	Assisting the warehouse manager in participating in daily, weekly and monthly counts, root-cause variances and share necessary reports.
	Assisting the warehouse manager in managing stock handlers under you to ensure maximum productivity.


Minimum Requirements


	Candidates should possess a BSc / HND.
	1 - 3 years of experience in logistics is required.
	Must be a matured, responsible and well mannered
	Computer literacy is a must.


Benefits


	Salary: N100,000 per month. 
	Annual leave allowance.
	Health Insurance Cover.
	Career development programs.


Application Closing Date: 19th August, 2026. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and preferred location as the subject of the email.
